feature_contract.goal: Preserve caller-requested D3D9 texture resource semantics for original vehicle-select and menu DDS replacements, allowing original native D3DX conversion or mip generation when the fast-copy path cannot honor them.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Fast path only returns matching caller format or D3DX sentinel, otherwise original D3DX creates requested texture.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Declared mip, autogen and unsupported mip requests
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Exact existing mip copied; explicit auto/oversized mip count falls back to original loader; original UV, FFB and world unaffected.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: DX9Ex R84 package, host, source impact
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Portable smoke, mutation guard and exact GitHub full mandatory CI after branch integration; Quest3 remains untested.

validation_command: GitHub exact-SHA DX9Ex Active + Domain + HUD Inspector + Full Source Impact
notes: C2 material candidate built on isolated feature branch while independent target CI is running. Do not fast-forward target or mark C6 until all exact SHA gates pass. D3DX request divergence is source-confirmed; connection to observed HMD white sprites remains unproven. No runtime HMD test.
